real_name: Baba Ladla (real name kept in film; also spelled 'Babla')
real_life_notes: Another real Lyari kingpin who rose through the PAC's post-Dakait fragmentation. Baba Ladla was killed in 2015 in an encounter with police / rival faction — exact circumstances disputed. Part of the second tier of Lyari underworld that proliferated after Rehman Dakait's 2009 death.
film_role: Film 1/2 — second-tier Lyari gang leader. Represents the succession chaos that followed Rehman Dakait's death. Relevant to Film 2's post-Dakait power vacuum context.
objective: Carve out territory in post-Dakait Lyari; survive the PAC fragmentation
real_death: Killed 2015 — encounter with law enforcement or rival faction, exact attribution unclear.
